coverage_questions: The paper does not document internal image patch extraction, visual-token construction, text tokenization, or multimodal fusion for TeamPath-7B, o4-mini, or the router.
The paper does not identify the exact language-model tokenizer, image encoder, visual-token axes, attention masks, positional encodings, or serialized decoder receipt.
The paper states that a linear regressor decodes natural-language information into gene-expression levels, but does not document the numerical representation supplied to that regressor.
The paper documents ten caption-training prompt variants and ten cross-modality-training prompt variants, but does not specify example-to-variant assignment or the exact inference prompt.
The paper does not establish whether target answers, captions, ranked gene lists, or reasoning paths are supplied as teacher-forcing inputs or remain supervision targets during fine-tuning.
